payload.title: Author the token set natively at final sizes in core (no multiplier, no dual stylesheet)
payload.description:
What: one token file (type scale, spacing on a 4px rhythm, one image ratio, text floors as tokens) per breakpoint class, in the sizes people see; core emits one stylesheet. No scale factor appears anywhere.
Acceptance:
Scenario: One stylesheet at every width
  Given the shared tokens
  When a site is built
  Then one stylesheet is emitted and no generated scaled copy exists
Scenario: Text never falls below its floor
  Given any breakpoint
  When computed font sizes are read in the browser
  Then every text role is at or above its floor token
